messages:
Maya: morning — nightly eval flagged a regression after we merged the promptset v5 changes. F1 down ~6% on conv_ref and increased hallucinations. eval-bot attached the summary link.

eval-bot: nightly-evals/1782005432: model=redwood-ggml-1.3-q4_0, promptset=prompts-v5, delta_f1=-0.062, examples_failed=34/500. full report: https://internal/evals/1782005432

Samir: ugh. Any obvious diff in the prompts? @Maya can you paste the prompt diff so we can triage quickly?

Maya: quick diff — we tightened the system instr and removed clarifying question guidance. snippet:
```- system: You are a helpful assistant.
- When ambiguous, ask clarifying questions.
+ system: You are a concise assistant.
+ Do not ask clarifying questions.``` 

Julia: that looks risky for convo tasks. Who approved removing the clarification line?

Raju: that was the docs team change (PR #4872). They wanted terser outputs for the UI. I flagged the risk but they asked to proceed.

Kevin: worth noting the failing eval used q4_0 quantization. Could the quantization interact badly with the prompt wording? We saw sensitivity before.

Samir: good point. Let's isolate: re-run the nightly eval matrix on both fp16 and q4_0 for prompts v4 (previous) and v5 (current). If v5 fails on fp16 it's a prompt issue; if only q4 fails it's quant.

Maya: starting matrix run: models [redwood-ggml-1.3-fp16, redwood-ggml-1.3-q4_0] x prompts [v4, v5]. I'll post results when ready.

eval-bot: job queued: eval-1782005432-matrix (ETA ~18m)

Julia: quick decision tree: v4+q4 passes & v5+fp16 fails -> prompt. v5+fp16 passes & v5+q4 fails -> quantization-interaction. both fail -> prompt change is main culprit.

Raju: I looked at sampling stats from earlier runs. v5 on q4 shows higher token entropy for the convo turns. snippet: ```v4-q4: avg_entropy=2.4
v5-q4: avg_entropy=3.1``` — more erratic choices.

Maya: good catch. If prompt is the cause we should revert the 'no clarifying questions' line and request a rebaseline. Who can approve a rollback? product owns prompt tone.

Samir: product (MA) needs to sign off. @Maya please open a rollback PR that selectively reverts that single instruction and tag product for approval.

Maya: will open PR 4921 in a few mins and attach failed-example list + eval heatmap.

Kevin: 👍 Prefer revert+rebaseline over flipping the whole promptset. Keep change scoped.

Julia: agree. Also suggest adding a Canary rule to block prompt edits that remove clarifying guidance for convo promptsets going forward.

eval-bot: update: eval-1782005432-matrix finished. Results summary: v4-fp16: baseline; v5-fp16: delta_f1=-0.04; v4-q4: baseline; v5-q4: delta_f1=-0.07. Full CSV: https://internal/evals/1782005432/matrix.csv

Maya: OK — both quant and prompt matter but prompt change looks primary (v5 on fp16 still -4%). I'll create the rollback PR and request product approval + rebaseline run.

Samir: thanks. Also add an automated unit test that flags prompts that instruct "do not ask clarifying questions" for convo-style promptsets.

Maya: adding test to PR 4921 and will tag @product/MA. Will follow up with rebaseline once PR merges.

Kevin: thanks all — good triage. Keep this thread updated, and bump in #incidents if customer-facing regressions show up.
